book.name: FILIPENSES
book.title: U Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLOXEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU FILIPOS U uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Filipos uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ tok iqꞌii u Cristo

As ootzimal svaꞌn, vitzꞌin vatzik, uvaꞌ niyakꞌin etaanxelal tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ atoꞌk ex kꞌatz u Cristoeꞌ. As nechiibꞌeꞌ, tan xoꞌn ex te Aak. As unvatzul kuxh vetxumbꞌaleꞌ tukꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritueꞌ. As nitxum tibꞌ evatz sevatzaj.

Estiꞌeꞌ nunjaj bꞌaꞌnil sete, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la eyakꞌinsa u chiibꞌichileꞌ tu u vaanxelaleꞌ. As eela koj chit eyoloneꞌ sevatzaj. As eela koj chit exoꞌnit etibꞌ sevatzaj. As unvatzul koj chit etxumbꞌal la ibꞌaneꞌ.

Yeꞌ la ebꞌan umaj txumbꞌal uvaꞌ la ok exoꞌl staꞌn. As yeꞌ la etoksa jeꞌ eqꞌii tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam la ebꞌaneꞌ. Pet tukꞌ mutxkin aamail la etoksa iqꞌii unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ at sexoꞌl, tan at itxumbꞌaleꞌ taꞌn u Cristoeꞌ.
As jit kuxh uveꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn sete. Pet aꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ.
As ech vetxumbꞌaleꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ vitxumbꞌal u Jesucristo uvaꞌ kat ibꞌana.

content.text: As tul Tiixh Aak. As yeꞌ kat ijeꞌsa tibꞌ Aak tiꞌ toksat iqꞌii
tukꞌ u tijleꞌmeꞌ uvaꞌ Tiixh Aak.
Pet kat inima Aak uvaꞌ ech Aakeꞌ naj kat ibꞌana.
As kat ok veꞌt Aak echeꞌ umaꞌl u kꞌam,
tan ech veꞌt Aakeꞌ echeꞌ vatz txꞌavaꞌilla aama kat ibꞌana.
As tul echik veꞌt Aakeꞌ echeꞌ umaꞌl uxhchil,
as yeꞌ kat ijeꞌsa tibꞌ Aak tiꞌ toksat iqꞌii.
Pet niman yol Aak kat ibꞌana, techal kat yatzꞌpu veꞌt Aak vatz umaꞌl u kurus.
Estiꞌeꞌ nim kat toksakat u Tiixheꞌ iqꞌii Aak tiꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil.
As kat toksa u Tiixheꞌ iqꞌii vibꞌii u Jesús tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil,
kꞌuxh eyen tu almikaꞌ, moj vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, pet moj jaqꞌ u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ la qaaebꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil vatz u Jesúseꞌ.
As la tal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ u Jesucristo u Bꞌooqꞌoleꞌ.
As ech toksat unqꞌa tenameꞌ iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ.

content: Ni taqꞌ u Pablo itxumbꞌal unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús

As la val sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, ex uvaꞌ xoꞌn ex sve: Ech la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ kat ibꞌan u Cristo. As kam enimat u Tiixheꞌ bꞌenameen uvaꞌ atik in sexoꞌl, as echat la ebꞌaneꞌ cheel, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ nexoꞌva Aak. As kꞌuxh yeꞌl in sexoꞌl, as ayaꞌloj chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ, as tiꞌ ekꞌuchataꞌ uvaꞌ qꞌalpumal veꞌt ex taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ,
tan Aakeꞌ ni oksan xeꞌ etaama uvaꞌ la esaꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ. As Aakeꞌ la lochon ex tiꞌ ebꞌanataꞌ unpajte, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ nisaꞌ Aak setiꞌ.
As jankꞌal uvaꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ, as yeꞌ la eyol veꞌteꞌ. As mitaꞌn tukꞌ yaaibꞌ la ebꞌankat,

aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaj vaꞌlexhla yol la alpu setiꞌ. As jik chit etxumbꞌal la ebꞌaneꞌ, tan ex veꞌt meꞌal ikꞌaol u Tiixh. As ech ekꞌuchat veꞌt u bꞌaꞌneꞌ vatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh vitxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ itxijun unqꞌa txꞌumileꞌ vatz u almikaꞌeꞌ.

As ebꞌantaj u bꞌaꞌneꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ ekꞌuchat u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni aqꞌon etiichajil kꞌatz u Tiixheꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ la chiibꞌ in setiꞌ tu u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ la ul u Cristo unpajte, tan la ekꞌucheꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat el iqꞌii u vaqꞌoneꞌ uvaꞌ kat unbꞌan sexoꞌl.

As ootzimal svaꞌn uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, as u aqꞌoneꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌan tiꞌ Aak, as eela tukꞌ umaj oy uveꞌ nebꞌan vatz Aak. Asoj la kam in tiꞌ valat viyol u Tiixheꞌ sete, as la txuqꞌtxun in setukꞌ sekajayil. As ech la ibꞌan vunkamebꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌanchu tukꞌ u vino uvaꞌ ni peqꞌlikbꞌen tiꞌ u oyeꞌ uveꞌ ni toksal vatz u Tiixheꞌ taꞌn u nachol Tiixheꞌ.
As la chiibꞌ veꞌt ex, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. As la chiibꞌ veꞌt ex sviꞌ unpajte, tan ayaꞌl chit unkꞌuꞌl tiꞌ unnimat Aak.
Nichaj bꞌen u Pablo u Timoteo tukꞌ u Epafrodito tu u Filipos
Asoj la ibꞌan u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo bꞌaꞌnil, as tuk unchaj bꞌen u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Timoteo tiꞌ bꞌen iyakꞌinsat ex, as tiꞌ tul iyakꞌinsat veꞌt in unpajte tul la vabꞌi yol setiꞌ.
As yeꞌl umaꞌtoj uxhchil sunkꞌatz uvaꞌ ech itxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ u Timoteo, tan ni tok u Timoteo ilil setiꞌ.
Pet ech koj unjoltu unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tan aꞌ kuxh u tetzeꞌ ni titzꞌa. As nu koj titzꞌa setiꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni titzꞌa u Jesucristoeꞌ setiꞌ.
As ootzimaleꞌ setaꞌn uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn itxumbꞌal u Timoteo nibꞌaneꞌ, tan niloch in tiꞌ ipaxsal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo echeꞌ ilochat umaj kꞌaola ibꞌaal.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ tuk unchaj bꞌen u Timoteo sexoꞌl. Pet lanal vileꞌ kam tuk elojkat in.
As kꞌujleꞌl unkꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ uvaꞌ Aak tuk bꞌanon bꞌaꞌnil uvaꞌ yeꞌ la bꞌalaxtu veꞌt in tiꞌ bꞌen vilat ex unpajte.

Pet ni vitzꞌa uvaꞌ la unbꞌaxsa bꞌen u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Epafrodito sexoꞌl uvaꞌ ni lochon in tiꞌ talpu u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ nichꞌoꞌn taama sqiꞌ, tan exeꞌ kat chajon tzan tiꞌ ul ilochat in tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam nisaꞌvit sviꞌ.
As nitxum ex u Epafrodito. As nitxumun veꞌt taama setiꞌ, tan ootzimal veꞌt staꞌn uvaꞌ kat etabꞌi uvaꞌ kat ipalebꞌe umaꞌl u chꞌoꞌm tzitzaꞌ.
As an chiteꞌ, tan kat ipalebꞌe u chꞌoꞌmeꞌ. As bꞌiit kuxh yeꞌ kat kami. As kat itxum u Tiixheꞌ ivatz. As kat itxum Aak unvatz, tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ul umaꞌt txumuꞌm sviꞌ unpajte.

Estiꞌeꞌ techal chit tuk unchaj veꞌt bꞌen u Epafrodito sexoꞌl, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la txuqꞌtxun ex tul la etil tooneꞌ. As yeꞌ la txumun veꞌt vaama setiꞌ, tan at sunkꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ la txuqꞌtxun veꞌt ex tul uvaꞌ la ooni.
As achaꞌv ekꞌulataꞌ tukꞌ chiibꞌichil, tan qitzꞌin qatzik qibꞌeꞌ stukꞌ kꞌatz u Tiixheꞌ. As la chit exoꞌni aak tukꞌ unkaꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ ech itxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ aak,
tan tukꞌ kuxh unbꞌiite uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat kami tiꞌ ilochoneꞌ tiꞌ talpu u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo. As kat ipalebꞌe kꞌaxkꞌo tul kat echaj tzan tiꞌ ul ilochat in, tan yeꞌ kat uch etuleꞌ tiꞌ unlochpeꞌ.
